subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.**

It is __undesirable__ to invest a part of your earnings for future use.
solution:
The correct answer is "**advisable**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Undesirable **means not wanted or desirable because harmful, objectionable, or unpleasant. (अवांछनीय)

 
 
• *Example: "the drug's **undesirable **side effects"*
 
 
 
• **Advisable** refers to something that is appropriate for suggestion or recommendation; (of a course of action) to be recommended; sensible. (उचित)
 
 
• *Example: It is **advisable **to carry one of the major credit cards.*
 
 
 
• Thus, **'**advisable**' **is the ***correct antonym*** for **'undesirable****'. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's have a look at the **meaning **of other words given in options:-

 
 
• **Foolish - **lacking good sense or judgement; unwise. (अच्छी समझ या निर्णय की कमी; नासमझ)
 
• **Unadvisable - **not capable of being advised. (अनुचित)
 
• **Meek - **quiet, gentle, and easily imposed on; submissive. (नम्र)
 
 
 
• The antonym for foolish is ***sensible***.
 
• The antonym for unadvisable is ***advisable***.
 
• The antonym for meek is ***impatient***.
